newsitem.title: USA: Lakehead Pipe Line Partners LP Q4 net up.
newsitem.headline: Lakehead Pipe Line Partners LP Q4 net up.

text.p: (dollars in millions, except per unit amounts)

NOTE: Revenues for 1996 reflect agreement between Lakehead and customer representatives on contested tariff rates that resulted in an approximate tariff reduction of six percent and total rate refunds and related interest of $120.0 million through October 1, 1996. Refunds of $41.8 million were made in Q4 1996, with the remaining balance to be repaid through a 10 percent reduction on future rates. This reduction will continue until all refunds made, which the company said will take about three years. The company provided $42.6 million of rate refunds and related interest in 1996 to reflect the settlement agreement, which was approved by federal authorities in October 1996.

Recalculated net income for 1996 was $75.5 million or $3.06 a share, up from recalculated net income for 1995 of $63.8 million or $2.60 a share. Recalculated earnings includes the impact of the tariff rate agreement on just 1996 and 1995 and excludes any amounts related to prior years.
